purpose: Keys that must not become verified history yet. The importer keeps their raw matches, provisional approvals and offers untouched, but the key stays review_required and no rows are published.

holds.reason: Package size of the offer is unverified (offer_quantity_flags.json) and the three provisional approvals have not been approved by Casper.

release_rules: A hold is lifted only when (1) the quantity flag of the offer is lifted with documented evidence (automatic quantity_unverified hold disappears) AND (2) a release entry {key, approved_by: 'Casper', approved_on, note} is added here after Casper has explicitly approved the matches.
